title: Reserve a requested rent with valid details
gherkin:
Feature: Requested-rent reservation
  Scenario: Successfully reserve a requested rent
    Given a user has submitted a rental request
    When the user reserves the requested rent
    Then the reservation status should be set to 'reserved'
    And the reservation timestamp should be recorded
    And the requested rent should no longer be available for other users
rationale: Validates the basic happy path for reserving a requested rent, ensuring the system correctly transitions the request to a reserved state and prevents double-booking.
generationSummary: Test cases for requested-rent reservation semantics covering the core behaviors and edge cases of how rental requests are reserved, managed, and processed in a hybrid rental system.

title: Prevent reservation of already reserved requested rent
gherkin:
Feature: Requested-rent reservation
  Scenario: Attempt to reserve an already reserved requested rent
    Given a requested rent is already reserved by another user
    When a different user attempts to reserve the same requested rent
    Then the reservation should fail
    And an error message should indicate the rent is unavailable
    And the original reservation should remain unchanged
rationale: Ensures the system enforces mutual exclusivity of reservations and prevents concurrent reservation conflicts.
